issues.description: Class member visibility for Bitmap24: in template/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp the constructors and public API (Bitmap24(), Bitmap24(int,int), ~Bitmap24(), resize_buffer, save, set) are declared under the private section. In solution/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp those same members are declared public. The example program (template/example_program/src/main.cpp) constructs Bitmap24 and calls bitmap.resize_buffer(...) and bitmap.set(...). Having these constructors and methods private in the template will cause compilation errors and prevent students from using the example code as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the access specifier in template/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp so the intended API is public. Add a 'public:' label before the constructor and method declarations (Bitmap24(), Bitmap24(int,int), ~Bitmap24(), resize_buffer, save, set) or move those declarations into an existing public: section. This makes the template header match the solution header and allows the provided example/main.cpp to compile and run while preserving the exercise intent.
